auth.title: Login log
auth.intro: The app logs in with a stored session (refresh token). This log shows when that did not work and the password was needed, and why. It is kept across restarts (last 50 events).

eu.title: Enhanced Polestar EU experience
eu.intro: Uses the official Polestar Data Portal (EU cars only, read-only) for extra data: average consumption and speed, trip meters, car alarm, tailgate lock, brake fluid and light warnings, charge and climate timers and usage mode. Create API credentials at data-portal.polestar.com; the account ID is on the API docs page there.
eu.secretPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep the stored secret
